Q's initial hit plus a second Stretching Strike; E's charge then a separately-resolved recast dash/impact; R's four bounces resolved 1s apart
While tethered, Zac's next basic attack is replaced by the second Stretching Strike (0.25s cast, on-attack but not on-hit/crit)
Both the initial cast and the empowered second attack reset Zac's basic attack timer
Elastic Slingshot channels up to 4.5s before dashing/dealing damage; other actions (Q, W) are restricted during the channel per the interaction table
Each ability costs a percent of health per cast (Q 8%, W 4%, E 4%), constraining how many casts fit in the 15s window
Unstable Matter's current cooldown is reduced 1s whenever Zac collects a Cell Division chunk, which his other abilities generate on hit

Cell Division's resurrection (extra life, untargetability, echoed bloblet damage, variable revive %) and the chunk self-heal do not add damage dealt; they matter only for how long Zac survives in the survival fight

needsBespoke.why: Cell Division's resurrection is a full secondary mechanic: on lethal damage Zac becomes untargetable/unable to act for a level-scaled duration, splits into four bloblets whose incoming damage (capped per-bloblet at their own max health) is echoed to him as true damage, and he then revives at 10-50% max health depending on surviving bloblet health, or dies outright if all bloblets die first. No primitive in the closed list expresses an extra, partially-independent health pool with its own damage cap and a variable revival outcome; this needs bespoke logic for the survival fight. Additionally, the chunk-drop/pickup loop that heals Zac and shortens W's cooldown depends on chunk spawn geometry (contestable vs. uncontestable placement) that a dummy fight must approximate rather than read off a primitive.

proposal: Start the fight with Let's Bounce! (R) already off cooldown, standing in melee range of the dummy so all four bounces land on it.

Immediately after R resolves, begin Elastic Slingshot (E): hold the channel only briefly (channel length doesn't add value against a stationary target) and recast onto the dummy for the dash-impact damage.

Cast Stretching Strikes (Q) at the dummy; since it is the only target, both the initial hit and the tether's empowered basic attack land on it for double Q damage — let the empowered attack fire as soon as the auto-attack queues.
Weave Unstable Matter (W) on cooldown throughout the fight (5s base cooldown, possibly shorter from chunk pickups) since it is free of cast time and can be re-cast repeatedly.
Re-cast Stretching Strikes on cooldown (8-14s depending on rank) between W casts, and fill remaining gaps with basic attacks to use attack resets.

Do not attempt to recast Let's Bounce! or a second full Elastic Slingshot cycle unless their cooldowns (90-120s and 9-21s respectively) genuinely come back up within the 15s window; prioritize Q/W uptime instead.
